standing_rules: At a new chat start read RULES.md from main and CHAT_SESSION_STATE.json from chat-session-state, then verify live GitHub state.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from lines intended to paste into OVMS Agent; all agent commands must be one physical input line.
GitHub is the development control plane/source of truth; VAX/OpenVMS is authoritative for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL, runtime, and generated/uncommitted acceptance.
Use GITAUTH as the standard prompt-free raw Git network path on VAX; never configure credential.helper store/global/askpass.
DEC C/VAX C89: declarations at block starts; external/link-visible identifiers <=31 chars; no implicit declarations.
Never claim an unpublished or untested GitHub head is VAX-green.
Canonical build acceptance requires All regression tests passed and final status %X00000001.
Do not stage known untracked M274 runtime/config/diff fixtures casually.
If OVMS Agent emits a redundant post-write Apply patch prompt after a successful write, do not approve the redundant proposal; exit and log #58 when relevant.
Never record credential values in durable state.
